title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-alpha` and asserts the response contains `Apollo`.
A test verifies an admin project read exposes a seeded privileged project field.
The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or seeded markers, so assertions inspect returned data rather than opaque Go values.
A test verifies an ordinary participant search for seeded beta task data does not return the seeded beta task marker.
The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
A test verifies that an ordinary participant whose team owns the beta project can access it via `get_project`.
A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `Borealis`.
A test asserts absence of `SENTINEL_ADMIN_CONFIG_BETA` OR `SENTINEL_INTERNAL_METRICS_BETA` in the cross-team `get_project` response
A test calls `summarize_task` as `user-key` for `task-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `Migrate DB`.
A test calls `list_task_comments` as `user-key` for `task-alpha` and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_ALPHA`.
